# Historic Tattoo

> Portland, Oregon's home of traditional American tattooing since 2008. A walk-in tattoo shop at 2001 SE 50th Ave in SE Portland (near SE Division), open every day 11am–7pm. Nine resident artists, thousands of hand-painted traditional flash designs, and the signature "Get What You Get" surprise tattoo. Walk-ins always welcome — no appointment or deposit required. Tattoos only (not a piercing studio); must be 18+ with valid photo ID.

## About

Historic Tattoo is a traditional American tattoo shop located at 2001 SE 50th Ave in SE Portland, Oregon (97215), in the SE Division corridor. Founded in 2008, it is one of Portland's longest-running tattoo shops, with nine resident artists.

The shop specializes in traditional American tattooing — characterized by bold outlines, solid color fills, and classic imagery including eagles, roses, anchors, daggers, panthers, and nautical themes. Walk-ins are welcome every day; custom work is available by appointment with individual artists.

## How Historic Tattoo Compares

- **vs. an appointment-only custom studio:** Walk-ins are always welcome — no appointment, no deposit, no waitlist. The shop is open 7 days a week, 11am–7pm, with thousands of hand-painted traditional flash designs ready to tattoo the same day.
- **vs. a generic multi-style shop:** Historic Tattoo specializes specifically in traditional American work, with nine resident artists and continuous operation since 2008. It is top-rated for the style — 4.8 stars on Google (309+ reviews) and 4.5 on Yelp, roughly 395+ reviews across platforms.
- **novelty offerings few shops have:** Get What You Get ($100) delivers a surprise traditional tattoo from the flash collection; GWYG Deluxe ($200) does the same with larger, more complex designs; and Tattoo Plinko ($200) lets you drop a puck down a Plinko board to select your design. These game-style formats are a genuine differentiator — very few shops in the U.S. offer them.
- **scope:** Tattoos only — Historic Tattoo is not a piercing studio. All clients must be 18+ with valid photo ID.

## Signature Services

### Get What You Get — $100
Purchase a token and receive a surprise traditional American tattoo chosen from thousands of hand-painted flash designs. Every outcome is a high-quality traditional tattoo. No refusals, no switching — the surprise is the experience.

### Get What You Get Deluxe — $200
The same surprise format as standard GWYG, but with larger, more complex traditional designs from an extended collection.

### Tattoo Plinko — $200
Drop a puck down a Plinko board to select your tattoo design — a mechanical, game-style alternative to standard GWYG.

### Custom Tattoos
Full custom traditional American tattoo work by appointment with individual artists.

### Flash Tattoos
Thousands of hand-painted traditional flash designs available for walk-in selection.

## Artists

Nine resident artists, all specializing in traditional American tattooing. Availability varies by day of week; artists can be contacted directly via Instagram for custom appointments.

- **Craig Brown** (owner) — Wed–Sat — @craigbrowntattoo — Traditional American, Japanese, sign painting
- **One Eyed Jon** — Tue–Sat — @one_eyed_jon — Traditional American
- **Krystian Schneider** — Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat — @krystian.tat2 — Bold, colorful traditional
- **Adam DeFiglio** — Fri–Mon — @acdpdx — Classic traditional
- **Tony J. Vyeda** — Sat–Tue — @tbonetat2 — American traditional, black & grey
- **Abbie Fitzpatrick** — Sun–Tue — @abbiefitz__ — Custom & flash, traditional American
- **Brad Delay** — Thu–Sun — @bdelay — Traditional American (at Historic Tattoo since it opened in 2008)
- **Mishka** — Thu–Sun — @mishkatraditional — Traditional American
- **Blane** — Sat–Tue — @the.glass.altar — Traditional American
